text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai Barat (Taiping-Banting)) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 31 Mei 2019.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai Barat

(Taiping–Banting) yang bermula dari kilometer 143.99 di koordinat U 421777.709,

T 333667.462 Grid Bentuk Benar Serong di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 162.07 di koordinat U 438818.638, T 331585.659 Grid RSO Geosentrik

(GDM 2000) (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya Pesisiran Pantai Barat

(Taiping–Banting) di Persimpangan Bertingkat Banting) termasuk Persimpangan Bertingkat

Hutan Melintang, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Hutan Melintang, Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar

Teluk Intan, Persimpangan Bertingkat Teluk Intan dan jalan-jalan sambungannya, iaitu suatu

jarak sepanjang 18.08 kilometer, diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (WEST COAST EXPRESSWAY (TAIPING-BANTING)) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the

Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the

State Government of Perak, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (West Coast Expressway

(Taiping-Banting)) Order 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 31 May 2019.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the West Coast Expressway

(Taiping–Banting) commencing from kilometre 143.99 at coordinates N 421777.709,

E 333667.462 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

and ending at kilometre 162.07 at coordinates N 438818.638, E 331585.659 of the

RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid (both distances are measured from kilometre 0.0 of the

West Coast Expressway (Taiping–Banting) at the Banting Interchange) including

the Hutan Melintang Interchange, Hutan Melintang Entry/Exit Toll Plaza,

Teluk Intan Entry/Exit Toll Plaza, Teluk Intan Interchange and its link roads,

being a distance of 18.08 kilometre, is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
